description:
Find claims from a natural-language question.

    A question is matched on its content phrases. When that match is empty,
    the longest content terms are searched as keywords. Those hits stay on
    strategy question, set fallback to keyword, and use the same hybrid score
    as query_claims: keyword overlap, then a domain match, then evidence
    strength. A keyword stays on the lexical match. Each hit includes
    match_reason, source_url when a paper link is known, up to two supporting
    claims, and one contradicting claim when one is stored. Full provenance
    stays on get_evidence.

    A domain keeps claims whose primary domain is that value or one of its
    aliases. cross_domain also keeps claims from other domains that carry
    the domain as a secondary tag.

    Use this when the input is a question instead of keywords.
    Example: search_smart(natural_language="How do transformers handle long context?", domain="ai-ml", limit=5).
    Example: search_smart(natural_language="What limits healthspan?", domain="longevity", limit=5).

cross_domain.description: Also return claims from other primary domains that carry this domain as a secondary tag. Default false.
cross_domain.title: Cross Domain

domain.description: Primary domain or an alias of it. Example: ai-ml.
domain.title: Domain

natural_language.description: A question or description of the claims you want. Example: How do transformers handle long context?
examples: How do transformers handle long context?
natural_language.title: Natural Language

offset.description: Number of hits to skip. Example: 0.
offset.title: Offset

name: search_smart

contradicting.description: One stored contradicting claim, when one is present. claim_id, statement, and strength.

match_reason.description: Why this hit ranked here: keyword overlap, domain match, and evidence strength.
match_reason.title: Match Reason

source_url.description: Stable link to the paper when one is known. Empty when the claim has no pointer. Full provenance stays on get_evidence.
source_url.title: Source Url

supporting.description: Up to two other claims from the same papers. Each has claim_id, statement, and strength.
supporting.title: Supporting

RelatedClaim.description: One claim shown beside a search hit.

source_url.description: Stable link to that claim's paper when one is known. Empty when it has no pointer.
source_url.title: Source Url

RelatedClaim.title: RelatedClaim

outputSchema.description:
question matches content phrases. lexical is a keyword query.

fallback is keyword when the phrase match was empty and the claims come
from a keyword search of the longest content terms.
outputSchema.title: SmartSearchResult
